class.name: SteamSocketConnectionResult
class.brief_description: Typed result of an incoming acceptance or outgoing handshake.
class.description: Outgoing success yields an authenticated connection. For incoming success, wait for [signal SteamSocketConnection.connected] or check [method SteamSocketConnection.is_connected] before sending.

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns the issued handle when the result succeeded.

members.member: The owned handle, or [code]null[/code] on failure.
